identity.label: stone well ring with two timber posts and pitched roof

footprint.coordinate_frame: local-east; origin is authored physical ground-contact centroid (wall-mounted: mount centroid); +X projects down/right and +Y down/left in east art

overall_extent_cells.note: An envelope for assembly extent, not a filled solid collider.

footprint.solid_representation: union of the listed physical_components in 3D; bounds/polygon alone must not be filled

physical_components.name: post 1
physical_components.note: Post top meets the underside of the authored roof ridge. Axis and radius define this estimated member; z_steps is axis interval, not radius-expanded solid bounds.

physical_components.name: post 2
physical_components.note: Post top meets the underside of the authored roof ridge. Axis and radius define this estimated member; z_steps is axis interval, not radius-expanded solid bounds.

physical_components.name: two pitched wood roof surfaces
physical_components.note: Explicit panel outer/inner quads are authoritative for the two roof solids. Their vertical extrusion is normal thickness / cos(45-degree estimated pitch). Only the thin panels and edge faces are filled, never the volume beneath the roof envelope.
physical_components.ridge_orientation_local_east: parallel to local X; inferred from the E original down-right ridge tangent, a single assembly orientation

panels.name: negative-Y roof slope
panels.closed_sides: join corresponding outer/inner edges only; no volume below panels

panels.name: positive-Y roof slope
panels.closed_sides: join corresponding outer/inner edges only; no volume below panels

soft_or_empty_regions.name: water/shaft interior
soft_or_empty_regions.note: Subterranean depth is unspecified; -1 is clearance proposal, not measured well depth.

blocking.movement: actual hard member union; preserve openings and interior voids
blocking.rays: actual material surfaces at their z; no whole silhouette occluder
blocking.native_selection: handoff only; no runtime behavior/binding selected

notes: Stone floor contact is separate from timber post feet. Blue water does not select fluid behavior.
Roof panel vertices, ridge direction, 0.025-cell normal plank thickness and support heights are qualified visual proposals. Post tops meet ridge underside; ground tips/media pivots remain unchanged.

animation_registration.interpretation: Animation/media registration only, not a contact/footprint/mount height. No offsets or states adjusted.

source_geometry_limitations.method: Blender source-UV thin meshes with semantic material masks and keyed authored deformation. Support buckling precedes connected cloth folding; source-visible rims and sides detach separately. No filled hull or voxel partition. Every raw frame rendered in Blender.
source_geometry_limitations.limitation: Each camera has a separately source-mapped Blender mesh collection, not a shared 3D model or simulation. Hidden faces cannot be recovered. C3 rear-wheel hidden rim is explicitly inferred and revealed as the barrel moves away. B23 has an explicitly inferred undecorated source-palette bottom/edge behind detached sides and lid. Floor and bones lower together after support loss; the hidden interior is not recovered original geometry. Cloth folds and cage buckling are authored shape keys. Source shadows are retained. No physical-validity or release-approval claim.
source_geometry_limitations.blender_inspection: not opened; no geometry dimensions claimed from Blender; source metadata explicitly describes directional painted surfaces rather than certified native collision
